videos.title: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [Tutorial]
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Mike Dane
videos.note: Foundation refresher: data types, collections, functions, exceptions and classes. Follow each selected topic with bundled Python scenarios; old setup screens may differ from current Python.

videos.title: AsyncIO, await, and async - Concurrency in Python
videos.creator: Socratica
videos.note: Concept introduction to coroutines, concurrency and async/await. Use current asyncio docs for TaskGroup, cancellation and timeout details, then run bundled queue/cleanup/single-flight assignments.

videos.title: Python API Development - Comprehensive Course for Beginners
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Sanjeev Thiyagarajan
videos.note: API routes, validation, database integration, authentication and tests. Older course APIs/deployment choices can differ; current FastAPI docs and bundled tested requirements govern executable assignments.

videos.title: Python Django 7 Hour Course
videos.creator: Traversy Media / Dennis Ivy
videos.note: Project-based Django views, ORM, forms and authentication. Title identifies course; choose relevant sections rather than replacing coding time. Current Django 5.2 docs govern this project's reference fixtures.

videos.title: Learn Flask for Python - Full Tutorial
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Coding with Jake
videos.note: Flask app and routing introduction. Older framework code can drift; use current Flask tutorial before extending app factory, upload and signed-webhook scenarios.

videos.title: Population and Estimated Parameters, Clearly Explained!!!
videos.creator: StatQuest with Josh Starmer
videos.note: Focused statistics lesson on population parameters and estimates. Pair with local sampling, confidence-interval and leakage exercises; this video does not cover every statistics topic.

videos.title: Machine Learning for Everybody – Full Course
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Kylie Ying
videos.note: Supervised/unsupervised model foundations and examples. Some neural-network sections use TensorFlow; this curriculum's implementation track remains Python/scikit-learn/PyTorch.

videos.title: PyTorch for Deep Learning & Machine Learning – Full Course
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Daniel Bourke
videos.note: Tensor fundamentals, training workflow, classification and model experiments. Select material matching current module; use current PyTorch docs for changed APIs and device behavior.

videos.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out.
videos.creator: Andrej Karpathy
videos.note: Code-level transformer and language-model construction. Requires Python/PyTorch foundations. Rebuild a small component and explain causal attention rather than copying an entire training run.

references.title: Hugging Face LLM course: transformer models

videos.title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
videos.creator: Andrej Karpathy
videos.note: General-audience technical overview of LLM behavior and training. Pair with local prompting, structured-output and failure-case assignments; no provider account is required for bundled teaching.

videos.title: Learn RAG From Scratch – Python AI Tutorial from a LangChain Engineer
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Lance Martin
videos.note: RAG pipeline concepts and Python examples. Framework/provider calls in video are optional; bundled lexical fixtures run locally and do not prove embedding or LLM answer quality. Follow current retrieval docs for API drift.

references.title: LangChain retrieval concepts and current APIs

videos.title: Tips for building AI agents
videos.creator: Anthropic
videos.note: Creator discussion on agent design and pitfalls. Use as design context; apply local policy, approval, tool-budget and uncertain-effect scenarios before adopting a framework.

videos.title: MLOps Course – Build Machine Learning Production Grade Projects
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org
videos.note: Project-oriented model operations introduction. Older ZenML and deployment APIs may differ; compare with current MLflow docs and test data/model lineage and rollback locally.

videos.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner Certification Course 2026 (CLF-C02) - Pass the Exam!
videos.creator: freeCodeCamp.org / Andrew Brown
videos.note: Broad cloud, security and AWS service concepts. Supplement architectural study; certification coverage is not a guarantee of principal-level readiness. Verify live pricing separately before real provisioning.

videos.title: OWASP TOP 10 for LLM01: Prompt Injection
videos.creator: Vandana Verma
videos.note: Focused prompt-injection explanation from creator's LLM-security series. Follow current OWASP risk guidance; prompts alone cannot replace application authorization or egress policy.

references.title: OWASP Gen AI security risk catalog

videos.title: Java Tutorial for Beginners
videos.creator: Programming with Mosh
videos.note: Optional Java language refresher; experienced architects can skip basics. Use Oracle migration guide for actual JDK upgrade decisions, compatibility tests and target-version behavior.

videos.title: A Guide To Managing Technical Teams
videos.creator: Continuous Delivery / Dave Farley
videos.note: Technical leadership and team effectiveness discussion. Practice truthful decisions, tradeoffs and observed outcomes using local behavioral templates; no fabricated career achievements.

videos.title: Deep Dive into LLM Evaluation with Weights & Biases
videos.creator: DeepLearning.AI / Weights & Biases workshop
videos.note: Evaluation workshop with RAG and LLM-evaluation topics. Older tooling can drift; use current metric definitions and keep retrieval, answer-quality, security and cost evidence separate. A model judge is not ground truth.
